title: exudyn.symbolic: the derivative as new nodes, a column of the table of operations
author: Claude-JG
description: Superseding #3108. The numbers of a Jacobian are given by the one-pass forward derivative (#3116), the table and SymbolicProgram (#3157). Still needed is the Jacobian as an expression - a flat program of its own - for the export of the Newton matrix (G1, numpy, sympy), the uniform evaluation on the GPU (RG14) and second derivatives: per operation code its derivative as new nodes from the derivatives of the operands, a column of the table instead of a function per node class, then Optimize; its cost and size against the one-pass derivative. After stage 3 of #3153.
releaseNotes: esym.Jacobian(expression, variable, optimize=True): the derivative of an exudyn.symbolic Real or Vector by a named Real or Vector as new expressions, each operation by the rule of the table of operations, vector and matrix operations kept as such; it can be evaluated, recorded, exported and differentiated again (Hessians)
